title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, web UI, and MCP server. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio using semantic similarity and keyword matching.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec), FastAPI for the REST API, and static HTML/JS for the web UI. It uses GitHub Actions for weekly reindexing, AWS S3/CloudFront for hosting, and Lambda functions for OAuth handling. The system combines TF-IDF inverted indices with vector embeddings for hybrid search.
how_to_apply: Use it to quickly locate past implementations of specific features (e.g., 'voice processing') across hundreds of repos. Integrate it into AI agent workflows via MCP to allow LLMs to discover relevant code snippets without loading entire repositories into context. Deploy it as a personal knowledge base or embed it in resume sites.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Hybrid semantic and TF-IDF search across repository READMEs and metadata
Auto-clustering of repositories into capability categories like Voice & Speech or AI & Search
MCP server integration for AI agents to search portfolio programmatically
Client-side faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and star count
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions to keep data fresh
Embeddable widget and shareable URLs for easy distribution of search results
